subject: Request: Temporary rotation & succession plan for ML infra IC during hiring freeze
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Temporary rotation & succession plan for ML infra IC during hiring freeze

Team,

Heads-up: Mateo (Sr. ML Infra Engineer) accepted an external offer and his last day will be 2027-04-01. He is the primary owner for the model-serving KV cache work and the live-scaling runbook. We do not have an active req approved to backfill due to the company hiring freeze that went into effect last quarter.

Impact summary:
- Short-term: two high-risk playbooks (cache recovery + scale-down mitigation) are single-threaded today.
- Medium-term: expected throughput tuning work planned for Q2 will be delayed unless we redistribute ownership.

Ask: I want to propose a temporary rotation + succession plan to cover core operational duties while we either get a targeted freeze exception or hire a short-term contractor. Specifically:
1) A 12-week rotation where Priya will take primary on-call for KV cache (40% load shift) and two platform ICs (names in attached rotation-matrix) will absorb backlog items.
2) Overlap weeks with Mateo (2 weeks) for knowledge transfer and shadowing.
3) Contingency: if freeze exception is denied, we engage TalentOps to provide a 60–90 day contractor placed on a capex line; cost will be owned by Infra (Karthik).

I've attached a proposed rotation matrix and a succession diagram for visibility. This needs approvals from HR (freeze exception guidance) and VP Eng (cost owner sign-off). Can each of you confirm next steps and whether you can sign the mitigation doc by EOD Friday?

Attachments: rotation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), succession_diagram.png (png)

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary rotation & succession plan for ML infra IC during hiring freeze

Raf / team,

Thanks for calling this out — Mateo leaving is high risk for our latency SLOs if we don't preserve operational continuity. Two quick notes from my side:

- We can fund a short contractor from the Infra discretionary pool for up to 8 weeks, but anything beyond that requires VP sign-off on a budget transfer (Finance will need a cost owner).
- Freeze exceptions are being approved on a narrow basis for operational continuity. Laura, can you confirm the template and timeline for the exception memo?

Operationally, Priya taking primary on-call for KV cache is sensible. I also want us to evaluate moving one lower-priority tuning project to Q3 to reduce load. If Priya is on-call + two IC rotations, we should minimize customer impact.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rafael: turn the attachments into the formal mitigation doc (link to Google Doc in Related Links) with explicit success criteria and rollback plan.
2) Laura: confirm HR's guidance for the exception path.
3) Grace: please validate the on-call schedule in the oncall-coverage-plan and call out any single points of failure.

If we get VP approval (cc: VP Eng later in the thread) I'll take responsibility as cost owner for the contractor option.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary rotation & succession plan for ML infra IC during hiring freeze

Folks,

Thanks for the clear plan. HR will consider a hiring freeze exception for operational continuity cases like this, but we need the following in writing before we can approve: a) mitigation plan with success criteria and exit criteria, b) identified cost owner, and c) confirmation that the role cannot be deprioritized without impacting customer SLAs.

Guidance and constraints:
- Short-term exceptions (up to 12 weeks) may be approved with VP Eng sign-off and an HR statement in the employee file.
- If you intend to engage a contractor beyond 90 days, procurement and payroll require a PO and vendor onboarding; allow 2–3 weeks lead time.
- Please avoid any informal reclassifications (e.g., converting project work into headcount) without formal approval.

I will review the Google Doc once you publish and provide a templated exception memo. Rafael, include a communication plan for internal stakeholders and customers (Monica cc'd) — HR needs to see how the change is messaged.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Temporary rotation & succession plan for ML infra IC during hiring freeze

Team —

I've scanned the rotation matrix and added a few nuts-and-bolts items to the attached oncall-coverage-plan:
- Priya can pick up primary KV cache on-call, but we need two runbook updates before handoff (cache-warm and emergency rollback).
- Recommend we pair Priya with Mateo for at least three shadowed incidents (not just knowledge transfer sessions).
- We should pause the medium-priority tuning project Rafael mentioned for 6–8 weeks to reduce cognitive load.

Operational ask: Rafael, can you add a page to the mitigation doc that lists escalation contacts, runbook owners, and the incident triage flow? Monica, please confirm how we tell customers if operational work will affect a scheduled maintenance window.

Attachments: oncall-coverage-plan.md (md)

Grace O'Connor
SRE Lead, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this is the right approach from CS/Support. A couple quick notes from my side:

- We'll own customer communications for any maintenance windows potentially impacted. I'll coordinate a 1:1 with Rafael to draft the message and we can route through comms once HR approves the exception.
- We can support a 4-week shadowing period for the primary on-call transition; beyond that we'll need a clear handoff checklist for customer-facing issues.
- For the interview panel if we decide to hire quickly after exception approval, please include Priya + one SRE and one infra PM. Jasper at TalentOps is ready to source contractors if Finance signs off — Jasper copied below on original thread earlier.

Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
